customers.evidence: With our partners, our coffee and our customers at our core

employees.evidence: Creating a culture of warmth and belonging

community.evidence: one person, one cup and one neighborhood at a time

shareholders.evidence: We are performance driven, through the lens of humanity.

integrity.evidence: Being present, connecting with transparency, dignity and respect.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, first-person plural voice with short bullet-form values. Leads with mission on human connection and neighborhood, then culture and belonging. Customers, partners and coffee named as core. Environment and safety absent. Absolute declarative wording ('We are performance driven'); no hedging or metrics.
